decision_rule: Native dry-run succeeds only if isolated CPU CMake configuration with compile_commands.json compiles the actual patched tools/llama-bench/llama-bench.cpp into an x86-64 ELF relocatable object and writes its actual SHA-256 plus numeric compiled_object_count=1 to FILLER_DRYRUN_RESULT_PATH after success. Full build requires the same one-file patch over exact C6 source/tree, independently preserved CPU and GPU C6 configure identities, successful llama-bench target builds in separate build-cpu/build-gpu directories, compiled --load-threads help acceptance for both, and unchanged CPU/GPU C6 store manifests and linked-library hashes. Build-only; no model run, benchmark, kernel promotion, or production/store mutation.
